  {"step": 6, "file": "g10/mainproc.c", "function": "proc_plaintext", "line": 829, "var": "pt", "code": "PKT_plaintext *pt = pkt->pkt.plaintext", "note": "Save pointer to the plaintext struct before it is freed"},
  {"step": 7, "file": "g10/mainproc.c", "function": "proc_plaintext", "line": 949, "var": "pkt->pkt.plaintext", "code": "free_packet(pkt, NULL)", "note": "Frees the PKT_plaintext struct via free_plaintext() and sets pkt->pkt.generic=NULL; pt becomes a dangling pointer"},
  {"step": 8, "file": "g10/mainproc.c", "function": "proc_plaintext", "line": 956, "var": "pt->namelen", "code": "extrahash = xtrymalloc(6 + pt->namelen)", "note": "READ 4 bytes from freed memory via dangling pointer pt; this is the use-after-free crash"}
]
EOF

3. `free_packet(pkt, NULL)` (line 949) frees the plaintext struct
4. `pt->namelen` (line 956) reads from freed memory → USE-AFTER-FREE
